objective: Command-line tool: add a subcommand 'top PATH [-n N]' that prints the N most frequent words of a text file (default 3), one 'word count' per line, most frequent first, ties in alphabetical order. Words are lower-cased runs of letters.
acceptance_criteria: 'top notes.txt -n 2' prints the two most frequent words with their counts
a missing file exits with code 1
